english: An urn contains $3$ red balls and $2$ black balls. A ball is drawn at random. If it is red, it is returned to the urn together with one more red ball; if it is black, it is kept aside. A second ball is then drawn at random from the urn. Then the expected number of red balls among the two balls drawn is ______.
hindi: एक कलश में $3$ लाल तथा $2$ काली गेंदें हैं। एक गेंद यादृच्छया निकाली जाती है। यदि वह लाल है, तो उसे एक और लाल गेंद के साथ कलश में वापस डाल दिया जाता है; यदि वह काली है, तो उसे अलग रख दिया जाता है। फिर कलश से दूसरी गेंद यादृच्छया निकाली जाती है। तब निकाली गई दोनों गेंदों में लाल गेंदों की प्रत्याशित संख्या ______ है।
solution: Expected number of red balls $=P(R_{1})+P(R_{2})=0.6+0.7=1.3$ (check from the leaves: $RR=\dfrac{2}{5}$, $RB=\dfrac{1}{5}$, $BR=\dfrac{3}{10}$, $BB=\dfrac{1}{10}$; $2\cdot\dfrac{2}{5}+\dfrac{1}{5}+\dfrac{3}{10}=1.3$)
solution_full: Tree diagram. First draw: red with probability $\dfrac{3}{5}$, black with probability $\dfrac{2}{5}$.

After a red first ball, the urn has $4$ red and $2$ black balls, so the second ball is red with probability $\dfrac{4}{6}=\dfrac{2}{3}$. After a black first ball, it has $3$ red and $1$ black, so the second is red with probability $\dfrac{3}{4}$.

Let $Y$ be the number of red balls drawn: $P(Y=2)=\dfrac{2}{5}$, $P(Y=1)=\dfrac{1}{5}+\dfrac{3}{10}=\dfrac{1}{2}$, $P(Y=0)=\dfrac{1}{10}$. $E(Y)=2\cdot\dfrac{2}{5}+1\cdot\dfrac{1}{2}=1.3$, which equals $P(R_{1})+P(R_{2})=0.6+0.7$.
originality_note: New: an urn reinforced on red and depleted on black, so the second draw is more likely red than the first (0.7 against 0.6), and the expected red count is read from a two-level tree (way 5: tree diagram linked with total probability). Closest known: Polya's urn, where the second-draw probability equals the first. Different because: the two update rules push in the same direction, so the probabilities change and the tree has to be computed.

concept_use.Probability via tree diagrams: The two-level tree with leaves RR, RB, BR, BB gives the distribution of the red count.
concept_use.Law of total probability: P(R2) = 7/10 is the total probability over the first draw.
